categories.requirement: ARM64 compute module, >=4 GB RAM, Linux, eMMC/NVMe, GbE, USB, PCIe, I2C/SPI/UART/GPIO/PWM
current-production secure element or TPM-class root of trust with protected keys and ECC/SHA-256
categories.note: Do not lock production BOM to ATECC608B; source a current recommended device

categories.requirement: 1x Gigabit Ethernet RJ45 with magnetics, ESD protection and LEDs
independent hardware watchdog with reset-reason visibility where practical
eMMC or NVMe; A/B update support preferred
12V or 24V auxiliary DC input with fuse/polyfuse, reverse-polarity protection, TVS and filtering
high-efficiency buck regulator sized for compute module and USB peak load
regulated 3.3V logic rail for security, sensors and I/O
4 independent PWM fan outputs and 4 tachometer inputs with fail-safe full-speed state
minimum PCB, inlet and outlet digital temperature sensors
auxiliary voltage/current/power telemetry; expansion for PSU sensing
UART/SPI/I2C/GPIO through replaceable vendor daughterboards with level shifting/isolation as required
optional CAN or RS-485 transceiver footprint
USB-C recovery/service, UART debug, reset and recovery buttons
4-layer minimum, protected external I/O, test pads, fixture-friendly manufacturing access
metal or flame-rated polymer enclosure with airflow path, service access and labels
